description:
Indexers competing to power /search/ on 5chan. The highest-scoring indexer answers searches; if it is unreachable, 5chan rotates to the next-highest. Anyone can open a PR on this file to add their indexer.

To be listed, an indexer must serve the 5chan search API over HTTPS with CORS open to 5chan clients: GET /api/search?q=&page=&limit= returning {query, posts, page, limit, total}, and GET /api/posts/<cid> returning {post}. Each post carries cid, community_address, post_cid, parent_cid, depth, timestamp, author_address, author_name, title, content, and the signed raw payload 5chan renders posts from.

The filename intentionally does not match 5chan-<code>-directory.json, so 5chan directory consumers ignore it.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/5chan-search-providers.json
